input.free_text_description: This system is a authentication platform that serves Admin, User roles. It manages core business objects including ad site, ad, auth permission rule, auth role admin. The platform provides capabilities for global exception handler, ad, ad site. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage ad site records, so that I can track and organize ad site data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage ad records, so that I can track and organize ad data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage auth permission rule records, so that I can track and organize auth permission rule data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage auth role admin records, so that I can track and organize auth role admin data effectively.
